title: Perforin triggers iron-induced mitochondrial damage to drive ferroptosis and anti-tumor immunity
title_zh: 穿孔素触发铁依赖性线粒体损伤，驱动铁死亡与抗肿瘤免疫
abstract: Cytotoxic CD8+ T cells and natural killer cells are critical effectors of anti-tumor immunity. Cytotoxic lymphocytes eliminate tumor cells by releasing perforin (Prf1), a pore-forming protein that enables granzymes (Gzms) to enter target cells and trigger both caspase-dependent and -independent cell death. Here, we uncover a previously unrecognized, Gzm-independent function of Prf1. We find that Prf1 directly induces tumoral ferroptosis, an iron- and lipid-dependent form of cell death. Mechanistically, Prf1-mediated pore formation drives endocytosis of the transferrin receptor, which increases cellular iron uptake. Prf1 promotes the formation of endosomal-mitochondrial contacts, which leads to mitochondrial iron accumulation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and tumor cell ferroptosis. Dietary iron supplementation suppresses tumor progression in murine tumor models in a Prf1-dependent manner. Higher Prf1 expression correlates with improved survival and enhanced response to immune checkpoint blockade in patients with cancer. These findings define a Gzm-independent function of Prf1 as a direct executioner of cancer cell death through ferroptosis.
abstract_zh: 细胞毒性 CD8+ T 细胞和自然杀伤细胞是抗肿瘤免疫的关键效应器。细胞毒性淋巴细胞通过释放穿孔素（Prf1）——一种形成孔洞的蛋白质，使颗粒酶（Gzms）进入靶细胞并触发依赖与不依赖半胱天冬酶的细胞死亡。本文揭示了 Prf1 的一种此前未被认识到的、与颗粒酶无关的功能。我们发现 Prf1 直接诱导肿瘤细胞的铁死亡（ferroptosis），这是一种依赖铁和脂质的细胞死亡形式。机制上，Prf1 介导的孔洞形成促进转铁蛋白受体的内吞，增加细胞铁摄取。Prf1 促进内体-线粒体接触的形成，导致线粒体铁积累、线粒体功能障碍和肿瘤细胞铁死亡。饮食铁补充剂在小鼠肿瘤模型中以 Prf1 为依赖因素抑制肿瘤进展。Prf1 表达水平升高与癌症患者更好的生存率和对免疫检查点抑制剂的更佳反应相关。这些发现定义了 Prf1 的一种与颗粒酶无关的功能，即通过铁死亡直接执行癌细胞死亡。
